result: Identified Matbench Discovery WBM as the leading nonsealed public candidate for per-structure energy error-distance calibration, but explicitly did not admit it as independent generalization evidence. MPTrj and sAlex are rejected as independent calibration sources because they are in the medium-mpa-0 training lineage. WBM requires exposure/dedup audit, exact dataset/version freezing, deterministic grouped sampling, and per-structure paired error-distance observations before calibration use.
